title: Candidates
goal: Find a candidate and open their assessment.

zones.name: header
zones.purpose: The same global discipline switch (SegmentedControl) in the page actions; the list shows the candidates interviewed against the current discipline's profiles.

zones.name: list
zones.purpose: One tile per candidate, the same language as the profile tiles: the name as the link, the profile and the target seniority as two separate MetaItem facts (never one merged string), and the verdict seniority as a Badge in the tile header when a verdict exists.

states.empty: EmptyState via the template's empty prop, reason no-matches, icon=search: the search matched nobody, the action clears it. With no candidates at all in the discipline the same EmptyState reads reason no-data.
states.error: Static seed data cannot fail to load; both empties above are the one EmptyState the template renders.

data: candidates of the current discipline: name, profile, target seniority, verdict decision if any
openQuestions: Whether one candidate can carry several independent assessments (an interview panel) is an open product question; the first pass stores exactly one.

behaviours.given: candidates whose profiles live in different disciplines
behaviours.when: the candidates list renders under one chosen discipline
behaviours.then: only candidates whose profile belongs to that discipline appear
behaviours.why: A candidate has no discipline of their own; the profile carries it, and the list obeys the same global scope.

behaviours.given: a discipline with no candidates while another has them
behaviours.then: the empty state names a discipline that actually has data, instead of a dead end
behaviours.why: An empty list with no way onward reads as a broken tool (the same rule as airun's empty cockpit).
